parameters.name: thickness_mean_tl
parameters.description: Mean film thickness in (110) trilayers (continuous; Gaussian weights over whole trilayers)

parameters.name: thickness_spread_tl
parameters.description: rms lateral thickness spread in trilayers (at least 0.3 TL is used, to keep the fit smooth)

parameters.name: roughness_tl
parameters.description: rms roughness of the film top in trilayers

parameters.name: eps_perp
parameters.description: Out-of-plane strain of the commensurate film vs bulk RuO2

parameters.name: interface_A
parameters.description: Top TiO2 metal plane to first RuO2 metal plane

parameters.name: relax_001
parameters.description: [001] relaxation of the film above the commensurate part (0 commensurate, 1 bulk)

parameters.name: coherent_tl
parameters.description: Commensurate bottom part in trilayers (rounded to a whole number; keep fixed)

parameters.name: b_top_extra
parameters.description: Extra B factor of the relaxed part

parameters.name: b_film_Ru
parameters.description: B factor of buried RuO2 Ru

parameters.name: b_film_O
parameters.description: B factor of buried RuO2 O

parameters.name: b_sub_Ti
parameters.description: B factor of TiO2 Ti

parameters.name: b_sub_O
parameters.description: B factor of TiO2 O

parameters.name: b_surf_Ru
parameters.description: B factor of Ru in the exposed (top) trilayer

parameters.name: b_surf_O
parameters.description: B factor of lattice O in the exposed trilayer

parameters.name: dz_Ru6f
parameters.description: Outward shift of top-layer 6-fold Ru

parameters.name: dz_Obr
parameters.description: Outward shift of top-layer bridging O

parameters.name: dz_Oip
parameters.description: Outward shift of top-layer in-plane O

parameters.name: dz_Rucus_vac
parameters.description: Outward shift of an empty CUS Ru

parameters.name: dz_Rucus_OH
parameters.description: Outward shift of a CUS Ru under OH

parameters.name: dz_Rucus_H2O
parameters.description: Outward shift of a CUS Ru under H2O

parameters.name: dz_Rucus_O
parameters.description: Outward shift of a CUS Ru under oxo O

parameters.name: theta
parameters.description: Coverage of the CUS sites (OH + H2O + O)

parameters.name: x_OH
parameters.description: OH share of the OH + H2O species

parameters.name: x_O
parameters.description: Oxo O share of the covered CUS sites

parameters.name: z_OH
parameters.description: Height of the OH oxygen above its CUS Ru

parameters.name: z_H2O
parameters.description: Height of the H2O oxygen above its CUS Ru

parameters.name: z_O
parameters.description: Height of the oxo O above its CUS Ru

parameters.name: B_OH
parameters.description: B factor of the OH oxygen

parameters.name: B_H2O
parameters.description: B factor of the H2O oxygen

parameters.name: B_O
parameters.description: B factor of the oxo O

parameters.name: el_z0
parameters.description: Onset of the bulk electrolyte above the top metal plane

parameters.name: el_sigma
parameters.description: Width of the electrolyte onset

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Overall scale of |F| (data = scale x model |F|)
